span.p: Human in the loop: the nurse enters data and answers at most one question round; the clinician decides at the gate.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 1. The case is ingested and the fields are validated.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 2. The local offline model turns the complaint into typed fields.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 3. The triage server matches SATS discriminators and classifies coverage.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 4. NEW: the planner decides what to do next. The model proposes one action from a closed set; a deterministic guard rejects anything inadmissible, malformed, or over budget and falls back to finish_investigation.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 4a. It may gather cited evidence, or 4b. ask the nurse one targeted question through MCP elicitation, or 4c. re-read the note, or 4d. stop.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 5. Deterministic code computes TEWS and returns a colour with citations. No investigation action can produce a colour.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 6-7. Evidence is surfaced without setting a colour; a verifier rejects any priority that arrives without a citation.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 8-9. Worsening vitals raise a second look; coverage decides deliver, clarify, or defer.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 10-12. Only a named clinician's approval writes a queue position, then a sourced case card is rendered.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Structural proof: finish_investigation is the only edge into score, commit keeps exactly one inbound edge, and the planner's action set contains no score, gate, or commit.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Every tool call is written to the hash chained audit log and the span stream. The whole path runs offline on synthetic data, with no external API.
